welcome.blessing: May this be a place that makes every Sunday lighter and your team's worship sweeter. Take a minute to set up the basics — we'll guide you.
welcome.step_templates_body: Sunday 10 AM, Wednesday 7 PM… so creating services takes one tap.
welcome.step_songs_body: Build your library — name, key, version. You can paste a YouTube link too.
welcome.step_service_body: Pick a date, drop in the songs, and you're ready.
welcome.step_share_body: Send the invite link from Band settings — one tap to join, no account needed.

hero.subtitle: Plan services, keep your song library in one place, and share the setlist with your team in seconds — straight to WhatsApp.

features.title: Built around the way worship teams actually work
features.subtitle: Three tools, working together so Sunday morning runs smoothly.
features.plan_body: Create services for any day, set the time, add notes — reorder songs with a tap.
features.library_body: Save songs with artist, version, key, BPM and YouTube link. Find anything in seconds.
features.share_body: Send the full repertoire to your team via WhatsApp or a public link — no app required.

steps.title: Get set up in minutes
steps.one_body: Sign in as the admin. Your team joins with a code — no separate accounts to manage.
steps.two_body: Add the songs your team plays. Mark the key, the version, and the link.
steps.three_body: Build the setlist for next service and share the link in your WhatsApp group.

donate.title: Support the project
donate.body: Repertorios is built to make worship leaders' lives easier. If it has helped your team, a small donation keeps it running and improving.

final.title: Ready for your next service?
final.subtitle: Sign in and have your setlist ready in minutes.

dashboard.no_upcoming_body: Tap to plan your next one
dashboard.no_upcoming_readonly: Your admin hasn't planned one yet
dashboard.upgrade_subtitle: Create a free account to make it permanent.
dashboard.upgrade_benefit_1: Save your access — no more depending on the invite link
dashboard.upgrade_benefit_2: Get assigned a role in the band (Keyboard, Bass, Choir…)
dashboard.upgrade_benefit_3: Sign in from any device with email + password

public.expired_body: This link is no longer valid.

donate.tile_subtitle: Help keep Repertorios free and growing

playlist.title: Setlist player
playlist.no_videos: No song in this setlist has a track or a YouTube link.

install.benefit_1: Open instantly from your home screen
install.tile_subtitle: Add to your home screen for faster access
install.installed_subtitle: You're already using the installed version
install.ios_step_1: Tap the Share button in the Safari bar
install.ios_step_2: Scroll and choose “Add to Home Screen”
install.ios_note: It has to be Safari. Chrome and other iPhone browsers do not offer the option.
install.sheet_subtitle_ios: On iPhone you add it from Safari in three steps. It lands on your home screen like any other app.
install.sheet_subtitle_android: You add it from the Chrome menu. It lands on your home screen like any other app.
install.sheet_subtitle_desktop: Install it from the address bar and it opens in its own window, no tabs.
install.android_step_2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
install.desktop_step_1: Look for the install icon at the end of the address bar
install.desktop_step_2: Or open the three-dot menu → Cast, save and share → Install
install.desktop_note: No icon there? Nearly always because it is already installed — look for it in your Start menu.
install.ios_note_wrong_browser: You are on another browser. On iPhone only Safari can add the app to the home screen: open this link in Safari.

assignments.section_empty_admin: You have not assigned the team yet
assignments.section_empty_hint: Tap to add who is playing this service

errors.dupe: That person is already assigned to that role

share.include_team_hint: Attaches the musician list to the message

bands.create_subtitle: You will be its admin. Your other bands stay as they are.
bands.create_first_title: You do not belong to any band
bands.create_first_subtitle: Create your own, or ask your leader for the invite link.
bands.join_hint: Invited to another band? Open its invite link while logged in and you are in — no second account needed.

push.sheet_subtitle: Notifications can arrive when you are assigned to a service and when the setlist is ready, so you have time to prepare your songs.
push.reason_assigned: Notifications when you are given a role in a service
push.reason_setlist: Notifications when a service's setlist is ready
push.reason_closed: Notifications arrive even with the app closed
push.permission_hint: When you tap Enable, your browser will ask. You just have to accept.
push.blocked_body: Your browser will not ask again. Tap the padlock next to the site address, find Notifications and switch it to Allow.
push.ios_needs_install: On iPhone notifications only work with the app installed on your home screen. It is Apple's rule, and it takes thirty seconds.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or install the app.
push.notify_team_confirm_body: A notification goes to the members of {band} who have them switched on.
push.notify_team_reach: It will reach {count} device | It will reach {count} devices
push.notify_team_nobody: Nobody on the team has notifications switched on yet.
push.error_no_service_worker: The app is not ready to receive notifications yet. Close it completely, open it again and try once more.
push.error_failed: Could not turn them on. Try again in a moment.
push.test_hint: Not sure it works on this device?
push.test_sent: Sent. It should show up in a few seconds.
push.test_none: Could not be delivered. Turn them on again on this device.
push.test_failed: Could not send. Check your connection.
push.error_push_service_unreachable: Your browser could not reach the notification service. This is usually the network; try again or on another connection.
push.error_server_unreachable: The subscription could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
push.test_not_configured: The server has no notification keys (VAPID) configured.
push.test_no_devices: This device is not registered. Turn them off and on again.
push.test_rejected: The push service rejected the delivery. Check the server log.

calendar.name: Name
calendar.notes_placeholder: What will happen, what to bring...
calendar.empty_day: Nothing on this day. Tap to add.
calendar.repeat_hint_generic: It will repeat on the same weekday
calendar.repeat_count: {count} entry will be created | {count} entries will be created
calendar.delete_series: Remove this one and the ones after
calendar.delete_series_confirm: This and every later entry in the series will be removed. Past ones stay.
